title: How To Break for Beginners | Apache TopRock Step | Breaking Tutorial with Bgirl Bonita

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: Bgirl Bonita breaks down the Apache toprock step with a friendly and encouraging tone. She combines clear verbal descriptions of weight transfer with slow-to-fast demonstrations.

lesson_structure.note: Bgirl Bonita introduces herself and the Apache toprock tutorial.
Explaining the weight transfer and foot slide mechanics.
Practicing the step slowly with counting.
Practicing at a slightly faster tempo.
Discussing upper body variations and style.
Adding variations like double steps or drop downs.

common_mistakes: Incorrect weight transfer location during the step

Progression from slow breakdown to faster practice
